# <span id="aanchor375"></span> Import Driver Editor

Accessing this form requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

When creating a new meter using the Meter Editor or Meter Quick Create, you can specify an import driver based on the type of files that will be imported for the meter.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

To import CFX files for a meter, you will need to install the Stndfx driver and set the meter to use this driver.

</div>

Use the Import Driver Editor to install import drivers that will then be available for selection when creating a new meter.

<div class="procedure">

To add a new import driver:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Import Driver** within the **Application** group.
3.  Click the **New** button.
4.  Click the **Load from Driver on Disk** button.
5.  Click the desired driver, and **OK**.
6.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 372;height: 240;" />

Click the **View Drivers on Disk** button to see all drivers available for installation, and drivers that have and have not been installed.

</div>

The Stndtfx and Stndpfx drivers cannot be loaded. These import drivers are automatically used by FLOWCAL when importing tickets or PROVEit files, respectively.
